name: Calendar
notes: Day and week, event cards, scheduling, series, Teams transcript import

features.feature: Calendar shows a rolling Week (yesterday, today, 5 ahead) or a Day; `#calendar` opens Week; the heading names the day or the range
Earlier ‹, Today and Later › move by a day or a week

Today's column has the line "now"; hours are sized to fit the working day; overlapping meetings sit side by side, as many as there are; four or more side by side show their names from the first letter, with name and time in the tooltip

A meeting block shows recorded (green), "Will record", past, and opens its card; a recorded call with no meeting shows as its own block that opens the call; a meeting's call is the one of its event recorded at its time — saved with this start (an arm, however early it was joined) or started from 10 min before it to its end, at least 30 min after its start; the one being recorded first, else the nearest its start — so a call of the same event at another time (a meeting moved or held again) is a block of its own, never the meeting's
Declined and cancelled meetings are greyed, "No notetakers" and "Transcript" (Teams has one) are tagged, all-day events sit in their own row
Without Microsoft 365 the calendar says "Showing today's meetings only…" and shows today's agenda; a read error says "Can't read the calendar"

A meeting's card: its title with × (Close), when and how far off (Today · HH:MM–HH:MM · in N min / now · N min left / recording / recorded / over), its kind and thread chips; one action strip (the main button and its prep side by side as pills, a line saying what happens or what it was recorded as); People (the organizer, then up to three names and +N more of all invited, or "N invited" without names; who declined left out), the series rule and Last time under small headings; it stays open across Day / Week; kept inside the calendar's grid — a block with no room either side gets it over its right part (#338)

The card offers one action by the meeting's state: Open notes, Import Teams transcript, Don't record (with the language it will use), Join & record + Record (without joining), Record it / Record when it starts; nothing for a declined, cancelled, no_notetakers or offline one; for a Zoom or Google Meet one only the line "Recording isn't available for Zoom (Google Meet) meetings yet."
Record when it starts schedules a coming meeting (`scheduled.json`), and Don't record takes it back
A scheduled meeting arms itself a minute before it starts and records when joined; it leaves the list once its recording starts, its arm is cancelled, its start fails or it ends
The card's kind chip sets the type for every meeting of its series ("You set this — for every meeting of the series")
"+ Thread" on a card adds the meeting to a thread (× takes a hand-added one out) or makes a new thread from it

A recurring meeting's card sets "Every meeting of this series": Record / Ask / Don't record (the default), the rule's own state shown and a pressed choice changing nothing, and its language; Record puts each occurrence in Record when it starts once
Join and record opens the meeting in Teams and records as soon as the user is in
Import Teams transcript on an ended, unrecorded Teams meeting makes a call from its transcript and chat (Importing…, its error, a notification); refused when Teams has none or a call exists

Right-click on a meeting opens a menu at the pointer with what its card offers: its main action, its prep, Add to a thread…, the series rule, Copy the Teams link (the Zoom or Google Meet link for such a meeting), Show details; arrow keys, Home and End move in it; Escape, a click elsewhere, a wheel or a resize close it, and the focus goes back to the meeting

A meeting whose invite has a Zoom or Google Meet join link (in Microsoft 365's online meeting, its location or its body; a look-alike host is not taken) is kept like a Teams meeting: it shows in the calendar and in Today with a small label naming its app ("Zoom", "Google Meet"); a Teams meeting has no label

Echo records Teams meetings only: a Zoom or Google Meet meeting is never armed — its card and Today row say "Recording isn't available for Zoom (Google Meet) meetings yet." instead of Record, `echoctl arm` / `echoctl join` with one fail with that message and arm nothing, and Record when it starts, a series set to Record, the "Record?" offer at its start and the tray's Upcoming leave it out; no Teams transcript is offered for it
